result.brief: 提出 HWM，将世界模型骨干潜变量映射到由广义坐标与动量构成的相位空间，用耗散哈密顿动力学推进并反变换回原潜空间，配合多步监督提升长时序预测稳定性。
result.reason: Structures latent state evolution (phase-space Hamiltonian dynamics) for action-conditioned embodied world models, improving long-horizon rollout stability; a latent-representation contribution, though evaluated in embodied settings.
